title: Featured artist, past participants highlight Zion National Park Art Invitational - NewsBreak
text:
By or for St. George News ,
1 days ago The 2026 Zion National Park Art Invitational will take place Nov. 2-7 in Zion Canyon, with works by featured artists on display and demonstrations planned throughout the week. Zion Forever Project, the official nonprofit partner of Zion National Park, in partnership with Worthington Gallery and the National Park Service, sponsors this annual event that brings together 16 accomplished landscape artists to celebrate the beauty and spirit of Zion through art, according to a news release.
